data.description:
Board request via chat (msg 148, human:forrest, #board, 2026-08-30 18:59Z), verbatim: "okay, lets make a #bizdev board with us and the new hires"

Gap (scoped across the two prior no-op ticks): store.createChannel() in apps/chat/lib/store.js already supports visibility:'private' + members, but the CLI at apps/chat/bin/chat.js:144-150 hardcodes public and passes neither — #board only exists because store.js:77-84 seeds it. Add `chat create-channel --visibility private --members <id,id,...>` support so restricted channels can be created without seed-code changes.

Acceptance scenario: create #bizdev as a private channel with membership = founders (agent:ceo-carla, agent:cto-owen) + the new research hires (agent:researcher-nadia, agent:researcher-elliot) + human:forrest ('us and the new hires').

Sequencing note: message 148 is still UNDELIVERED to Carla (blocked ticks could not mark reads). The first unblocked tick should deliver it via the normal inbox pull; Carla executes the #bizdev creation once this CLI support lands. This task is the CLI change only — the channel creation itself is Carla's act on the request.
data.title: chat CLI: create-channel gains --visibility private + --members — unblock #bizdev board request

data.body: Board request delivered and answered: msg 148 (#board, human:forrest) was read into agent:ceo-carla's inbox and replied to in #board main channel as msg 156 this tick. Confirmed to the board: membership will be agent:ceo-carla, agent:cto-owen, agent:researcher-nadia, agent:researcher-elliot, human:forrest (pending Forrest's veto on the cut), and I verified the gap myself — store.createChannel() supports private+members, the CLI passes neither, so no supported surface can create #bizdev correctly today. I declined to create it public or to write to the store around the CLI. CEO priority endorsement: direct board request — treat this as front of the engineering queue (already high; sequencing stays Owen's call). Owen's scoping note stands: this task is the CLI change only; I execute the #bizdev creation as my own act on the board's request once it lands.

Planning done (cto-owen). Board greenlight: #board msg 157 approving Carla's msg-156 scope; my ack posted as #board msg 158. Plan: thin CLI passthrough — parseArgs gains --visibility/--members, create-channel case passes them to the already-complete store.createChannel(); zero store.js changes. One CLI-level guard: --members without --visibility private fails loudly (store would silently ignore it — worst failure mode is a silently-public 'restricted' channel). No silent auto-add of --me to members; store's explicit error stands. Regression fence in the plan: public-path behavior byte-identical, AS-6/AS-11 oracle wording pinned (extend cli.test.js:96 to the flagged path), export exclusion of private channels already generic (store.js:735). apps/chat/README.md surface-inventory sentence must be updated in the same commit. Acceptance scenario = Carla's exact five-seat #bizdev command as a cli.test.js test; live creation stays Carla's act post-merge. Branch feat/AS-22-create-channel-visibility linked. Ready for a developer next tick.

Implemented per plan, commit 8cab529 on feat/AS-22-create-channel-visibility. bin/chat.js: --visibility/--members whitelisted in parseArgs; create-channel passes through to store.createChannel (visibility undefined -> store default; members split on comma, trimmed, empties dropped, no dedup, no auto-add of --me per plan); CLI guard: --members without --visibility private = usage error exit 1; USAGE updated. Output: public path byte-identical; private prints 'Created #x (private, N members)' with N read from actual membership rows (store.dmMembers) so dupes in --members can't overstate it — boring choice, plan didn't pin N's source. --json shape unchanged, no members key. apps/chat/README.md surface inventory updated (CLI can create private; no add/remove/visibility-change surfaces; #board re-seed guarantee unique to #board; no HTTP/UI creation). Tests: all 5 plan groups added to cli.test.js incl. exact-membership assertion for the msg-156 five-seat #bizdev scenario and the hidden-name 'unavailable' oracle fence on the flagged path. Full suite 103/103 green. lib/store.js diff empty (verified). ONE OUT-OF-PLAN HARNESS FIX, flagging for QA: cli.test.js run() now sets NODE_OPTIONS=--no-warnings for child spawns — on this machine's node v24.13.1, node:sqlite emits a PID-stamped ExperimentalWarning on child stderr, which broke two PRE-EXISTING stderr-identity tests (verified failing at HEAD before my change). App behavior unaffected; suppression is test-env only. Left undone (per plan out-of-scope): membership read surface, add/remove, visibility change, HTTP/UI creation. Live #bizdev creation is Carla's act after merge.

QA review (qa-priya, cold read of plan + branch diff): VERDICT PASS — recommend done + merge. No inline fixes made; nothing committed.

REVIEWED: plan .lattice/plans/task_01M1A1XEA8JQ0Q1TTHQT82AVMD.md vs git diff master...feat/AS-22-create-channel-visibility (apps/chat/bin/chat.js, test/cli.test.js, README.md + lattice state). Confirmed thin passthrough: zero diff to lib/store.js and store.test.js; store remains sole validation authority; only CLI-level addition is the --members-without---visibility-private guard, exactly as planned.

RAN: (1) node --test 'apps/chat/test/*.test.js' → 103/103 pass, incl. all 5 new AS-22 tests. (2) Hands-on against throwaway DB (never touched apps/chat/data/chat.db): msg-156 five-seat command → exit 0, 'Created #bizdev (private, 5 members)', store shows visibility=private with exactly the 5 requested ids; member sees channel + posts OK; non-member channels output (text+json) omits it; non-member post/history probes fail string-identically to a nonexistent channel. Public path: flagless create + --json shape unchanged. Abuse: --members w/o private → usage error exit 1 (also with explicit --visibility public); --visibility sneaky / private-without-members / creator-missing / unknown identity / whitespace-only members all exit 1 with store wording; dupes in --members collapse via OR IGNORE and reported count is actual membership (1); hidden-name squat on 'board' and on freshly-created 'bizdev' both yield exactly "Channel name 'X' is unavailable." — oracle fence holds; re-running the acceptance create as a member fails 'already exists' (pre-existing store semantics, unchanged).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA: all 4 PASS (acceptance scenario; existing tests green + empty store.js diff; new tests 1-5; USAGE + apps/chat/README.md updated and accurate incl. #board-only re-seed caveat).

METAWORK ATTRIBUTION (asked to verify): the CLAUDE.md + .claude/commands/advance.md hunks in the branch diff come solely from commit baa537e, authored by Forrest Almasi (board) — a pre-existing metawork commit the branch was cut on top of, not yet on master. developer-marcus's commits touch no protected top-level files. Clean. Separately: an UNCOMMITTED edit to .claude/commands/advance.md (inbox sweep via server API, not host sqlite) appeared in the shared worktree during my review — presumed orchestrator/board metawork per the CLAUDE.md corollary; left untouched.

NON-BLOCKING (backlog-worthy, pre-existing parseArgs behavior, violates no stated criterion): (a) a trailing value-flag with no value is silently swallowed — 'create-channel g10 --me X --visibility' creates a PUBLIC channel with no error; same for trailing --purpose. Harmless direction here (the dangerous case, --members without private, fails loudly), but in a permissions surface a swallowed --visibility deserves a hard error; suggest a small task to make parseArgs reject value-flags at argv end. (b) cosmetic: '(private, 1 members)' pluralization.
